text: {"lessons":["My account has risen overall, but that alone doesn’t mean I should trade more; I should stay patient and avoid unnecessary turnover.","Selling 20 shares of Stock A after a large gain reduced my exposure, but I should make such decisions based on my overall risk and needs rather than the gain alone.","A monthly loss can follow several gains, so I should keep the account diversified and avoid reacting impulsively to short-term changes."]}
